meta.title: Northwind Logistics: nightly export failure
meta.summary: Nightly CSV exports broke after release 4.2. Two missed fix dates later, the client's VP threatens not to renew.

sources.subject: Nightly CSV export to warehouse failing
sources.author: Hannah Lee (Northwind)
sources.body: Since your update last weekend our nightly CSV export to the Snowflake warehouse fails every night. The job log says "export completed" but the file only has headers. Our billing team reconciles invoices off this file every morning, so this is blocking us. Please treat as urgent.

sources.author: Minh Tran (Support)
sources.body: Hi Hannah, thanks for reporting. I've reproduced an empty export on our staging copy of your workspace. Logging this as a P3 bug for engineering. I'll update you daily until it's resolved.

sources.author: Minh Tran
sources.body: @ravi Northwind's scheduled CSV exports return headers only since 4.2. Repro'd on staging. SUP-4812. Any idea?

sources.author: Ravi Kumar
sources.body: Probably the timezone change in the 4.2 scheduler migration. Exports run at 00:00 in the workspace TZ and the date filter now uses UTC, so for anyone east of UTC the window is empty. Not a quick one. It's P3 so I'll pick it up after the sprint ends (Oct 1).

sources.author: Minh Tran
sources.body: ok thanks 👍

sources.subject: Re: Export issue blocking billing
sources.author: Hannah Lee (Northwind)
sources.body: Sarah, flagging directly since the ticket only says P3. Our finance team is now reconciling invoices by hand, roughly 3 hours a day. When can we expect a fix?

sources.subject: Re: Export issue blocking billing
sources.author: Sarah Okafor (Account Manager)
sources.body: Hi Hannah, so sorry about this. I've escalated it with our engineering team and we will have a fix in place by Friday, Sept 26. I'll personally keep you posted.

sources.author: Sarah Okafor
sources.body: FYI told Northwind we'd have the export fix by Friday. They renew in November so let's keep them happy 🙏

sources.author: Ravi Kumar
sources.body: @sarah Friday isn't realistic, that ticket is P3 in backlog and I'm on the billing sprint until Oct 1. If it's urgent someone needs to bump the priority.

sources.author: Sarah Okafor
sources.body: Hmm ok, I'll sort it out

sources.author: Minh Tran (Support)
sources.body: Update: engineering has identified a likely cause related to scheduler time zones. Still investigating.

sources.subject: OOO handover Sep 29 – Oct 6
sources.author: Sarah Okafor (Account Manager)
sources.body: Hi Tom, thanks for covering while I'm out. Accounts to watch: Acme Health (migration in progress, weekly call Tue), Globex (QBR deck due Oct 2), Initech (renewal paperwork). Everything else is quiet. Thanks!

sources.author: Hannah Lee (Northwind)
sources.body: It's Saturday and last night's export was empty again. Sarah told us this would be fixed by Friday. Is there an update?

sources.subject: Re: Export issue blocking billing
sources.author: Hannah Lee (Northwind)
sources.body: Sarah, the Friday fix didn't happen and nobody has replied on the ticket since Wednesday. Can you tell me what's going on?

sources.subject: Automatic reply: Re: Export issue blocking billing
sources.author: Sarah Okafor (Account Manager)
sources.body: I'm out of office until Oct 6 with limited access to email. For urgent matters please contact support@brightdesk.io.

sources.author: Minh Tran (Support)
sources.body: Hi Hannah, apologies for the silence. As a workaround you can trigger a manual export from Reports > Export > Run now, which uses the correct date range. Engineering is working on the permanent fix.

sources.author: Hannah Lee (Northwind)
sources.body: The manual export works but someone has to log in at 6am to run it and it takes a while for 40k rows. This is not sustainable. We need a date.

sources.author: Minh Tran
sources.body: @ravi Northwind is getting angry about SUP-4812, Sarah apparently promised Friday. Can we get an ETA?

sources.author: Ravi Kumar
sources.body: I'll pull it forward. Fix is small once I'm in it. I can get it into the 4.2.3 hotfix that ships Thursday Oct 2.

sources.author: Ravi Kumar (Engineering)
sources.body: Hi Hannah, Ravi from engineering here. Root cause is the scheduler using UTC for the export window after 4.2. The fix will ship in hotfix 4.2.3 on Thursday, Oct 2.

sources.author: Hannah Lee (Northwind)
sources.body: Thank you Ravi, finally a clear answer. We'll hold you to Thursday.

sources.author: Priya Shah (Release Mgr)
sources.body: 4.2.3 release candidate: PR #2291 (export TZ fix) is failing the DST integration test. Pulling it from 4.2.3 so we can ship the rest on time. @ravi can you fix for 4.2.4?

sources.author: Ravi Kumar
sources.body: ugh, yes. DST edge case for Southern hemisphere workspaces. Will target 4.2.4 next Tuesday.

sources.author: Priya Shah (Release Mgr)
sources.body: 4.2.3 shipped ✅ Release notes posted.

sources.author: Hannah Lee (Northwind)
sources.body: We updated to 4.2.3 but last night's export was still empty, and the release notes don't mention the export fix at all. What happened?

sources.subject: Northwind export – status
sources.author: Hannah Lee (Northwind)
sources.body: Tom, I understand you're covering for Sarah. Can you confirm whether the export fix was actually deployed?

sources.subject: Re: Northwind export – status
sources.author: Tom Becker (Account Manager)
sources.body: Hi Hannah, I checked our release tracker and the fix was deployed on Oct 2 as part of 4.2.3. It may take one more nightly cycle to take effect. Let me know if tonight's run still has issues.

sources.author: Hannah Lee (Northwind)
sources.body: Tonight's run is empty again. Tom says it was deployed, the release notes say nothing. We are getting contradicting answers from your team.

sources.subject: Escalation: Brightdesk export failure (2 weeks)
sources.author: Daniel Reyes (VP Finance, Northwind)
sources.body: Lisa, I'm escalating this to you directly. For two weeks our billing has depended on someone manually exporting data at 6am. We were promised a fix on Sept 26, then on Oct 2, and were told on Oct 3 it had been deployed when it clearly had not. Our renewal is in November and I need to understand what happened and who is accountable before we continue that conversation.

sources.author: Lisa Park (VP Customer Success)
sources.body: Just got an escalation from Northwind's VP Finance. Can someone tell me who owns SUP-4812 and what actually happened? I need the full picture before I call him.

sources.author: Sarah Okafor
sources.body: Back today. I told them Friday on Sept 23 based on escalating it, I didn't know it hadn't been reprioritized. Also it wasn't in my handover to Tom, my bad.

sources.author: Tom Becker
sources.body: I saw PR #2291 linked to SUP-4812 in the 4.2.3 milestone and assumed it shipped. Didn't see it was pulled.

sources.author: Ravi Kumar
sources.body: Fix is ready, DST test passing. Shipping in 4.2.4 tomorrow morning. I'll add a regression test for non-UTC workspaces.

sources.subject: Re: Escalation: Brightdesk export failure (2 weeks)
sources.author: Lisa Park (VP Customer Success)
sources.body: Daniel, thank you for escalating and I apologize. You're right that you received incorrect information. I'm putting together a full timeline and will call you tomorrow at 10am. The fix ships tomorrow morning in 4.2.4 and I will personally confirm your first successful export.

sources.author: Priya Shah (Release Mgr)
sources.body: 4.2.4 shipped ✅ includes PR #2291 (export TZ fix).

sources.author: Hannah Lee (Northwind)
sources.body: Confirming last night's scheduled export completed with 41,233 rows. Thank you.

sources.author: Minh Tran (Support)
sources.body: Great to hear. Marking SUP-4812 as resolved. We've also re-classified it as P1 retroactively for our SLA review.
